script.problem: The one line is more than one sentence.

terra.problem: “Defeated in the Valley of Siddim” happens in the valley, not at Gomorrah. The seizure of Gomorrah’s goods is connected to the city.
“The LORD Hears the Outcry” reports what the LORD tells Abraham, not an event at Gomorrah.
“Smoke Over the Plain” takes place where Abraham is looking from, not at Gomorrah. The smoke is over the land toward the cities.
Words such as “grievous,” “justified,” and “catastrophe” may be difficult for a 5th-grade reader.
